notes: Single-stage sysadmin change: flip an account's default login shell and make sure it lands in the persistent account database (failure mode: shell installed but never recorded as default). Generalization probe: the provisioner is re-executed on hidden user/shell pairs, and idempotency is exercised by running it twice. Small nonzero for dependent_stages (provision then consistent report), hidden_case_generalization, and interaction_statefulness (persistent /etc/passwd state). No tool breadth, pressure, or unsafe actions; buckets to easy.
